verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items address AI-specific data retention or deletion controls (e.g., no mention of data lifecycle policies for AI features, opt-out of AI training data, or deletion of AI-processed data); the evidence covers only general accounting features, integrations, and an MCP server listing. Missing for 10: any documentation on data retention/deletion policies for AI-native usage, AI training data opt-out, or deletion controls tied to Intuit Intelligence/Payroll AI features.
